items.quote: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive.
items.claim: Moses returned to Jethro and requested permission to go to his brethren in Egypt to see if they were still alive

items.quote: And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
items.claim: Jethro granted Moses permission to depart in peace
